title: Concept Acupuncturist: An Efficient and Precise Concept Erasure Method for Diffusion Models via Sparse Autoencoders
title_zh: Concept Acupuncturist：一种基于稀疏自编码器的高效精准扩散模型概念擦除方法

paragraphs.en: 提出ConceptACP，用可解释性定位与SAE特征校正实现高效精准的扩散模型概念擦除，遗忘成功率显著提升。 Diffusion-based image generation models produce high-quality images but may generate harmful or policy-violating content, motivating machine unlearning (MU) to selectively remove target concepts while preserving general capabilities. However, existing MU approaches often struggle with the distributed and entangled nature of concept representations, leading to inefficient optimization and imprecise edits when applied through large-scale fine-tuning over full diffusion trajectories. To bridge this gap, we propose Concept Acupuncturist (ConceptACP), a novel MU framework that integrates interpretability-guided analysis with inference-free fine-tuning for efficient and precise concept removal. By establishing mappings between semantic concepts and cross-attention blocks in the U-Net denoiser and localizing the most concept-relevant block for targeted optimization, ConceptACP avoids full diffusion trajectory optimization, thereby improving fine-tuning efficiency. To mitigate concept entanglement, we propose a feature-level correction mechanism based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where SAE-derived sparse, semantically meaningful feature activations are manipulated to construct targeted correction signals, which are then projected back to the output space of the corresponding block and used as supervision for precise concept removal. Consequently, ConceptACP eliminates the need for external inference-time modules while achieving efficient and fine-grained unlearning. Instantiated on SDXL-Turbo, ConceptACP improves the forgetting success rate by 36.34 percentage points in the standard one-step generation setting on average over the best-performing baseline, while preserving image quality and prompt fidelity, and generalizes effectively across other Stable Diffusion backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/Eran-Xia/ConceptACP.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ConceptACP，通过可解释性定位与基于SAE的特征校正，实现高效精准的扩散模型概念擦除，遗忘成功率显著提升。基于扩散的图像生成模型能够生成高质量图像，但可能生成有害或违反政策的内容，这促使机器遗忘（MU）被用于在保留通用能力的同时选择性地移除目标概念。 然而，现有的机器遗忘方法往往难以应对概念表示的分布式和纠缠特性，当通过全扩散轨迹的大规模微调来实施遗忘时，会导致优化效率低下且编辑不精确。 为弥合这一差距，我们提出Concept Acupuncturist（ConceptACP），一种新颖的机器遗忘框架，它将可解释性引导的分析与无推理微调相结合，以实现高效而精准的概念移除。 通过建立语义概念与U-Net去噪器中交叉注意力块之间的映射，并定位与概念最相关的块进行针对性优化，ConceptACP避免了全扩散轨迹优化，从而提升了微调效率。 为缓解概念纠缠问题，我们提出一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征级校正机制，通过操纵SAE导出的稀疏且语义有意义的特征激活来构建针对性的校正信号，然后将其投影回相应块的输出空间，作为精准概念移除的监督信号。 因此，ConceptACP无需外部推理时模块，即可实现高效且细粒度的遗忘。 在SDXL-Turbo上实例化后，在标准单步生成设置下，ConceptACP的遗忘成功率相较表现最佳的基线平均提升36.34个百分点，同时保持图像质量与提示词保真度，并能有效泛化到其他Stable Diffusion骨干模型。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Eran-Xia/ConceptACP 获取。
